preflight.note: Created after the operator identified that the completed provider-specific slice still left the shared cockpit Twilio-forward, and before changing selection, renderer, backend, tests, docs, or evidence.

acceptance_criteria.text: Model no selected telecom provider as a first-class local-only state instead of defaulting an unconfigured installation to Twilio, while preserving configured legacy Twilio and explicit Telnyx selections.
Make shared channels, compose, new-message, reviewed-outbox, health, and settings overview surfaces provider-neutral and derive provider wording only from an explicit active SMS/MMS edge.
Give Twilio and Telnyx equal configuration hierarchy while keeping their credentials, webhook models, portals, capabilities, and Twilio-only Voice behavior explicitly provider-specific.
Make provider removal and local-only transitions honest and reversible: never silently select an unavailable provider, and prevent sends until an explicitly selected provider is ready.

Add deterministic renderer, desktop-store, and backend coverage for local-only, Twilio, and Telnyx selection; rebuild and reinstall the Windows app; update docs and changelog; and pass full repository validation with durable redacted evidence.
